title: Care Academy Note on Title & Registration Services Temporary Tag Entitlements
content:
Under every Title & Registration Services service type the original temporary tag is issued at handover; what differs between service types is how many extension tags Kestrel itself allows, whether the buyer's documents must be complete first, and the extension tag validity figure of the service type.

| Service type | Original tag issued at handover | Extension can be issued from (calendar days before the current tag's expiration date) | Extension issued only after every required document has been received | Kestrel's own limit on extension tags | Extension tag validity figure (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | Yes | 7 | Yes | 1 | 30 |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | Yes | 7 | Yes | 2 | 30 |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | Yes | 7 | Yes | 2 | 30 |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | Yes | 7 | Yes | 2 | 30 |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | Yes | 7 | No | 3 | 30 |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | Yes | 7 | Yes | 2 | 30 |

## Questions the table answers

**Is Kestrel's limit the only limit on extension tags?**
No. Kestrel's own limit for the service type is applied together with the registration state's limit, and the lower of the two governs.

**What is the service type's extension tag validity figure?**
It is 30 days for every service type.

**Which service type issues an extension while documents are still outstanding?**
Only Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection; every other service type issues an extension tag only after every required document has been received.

**From when can an extension be issued?**
From 7 calendar days before the current tag's expiration date. Hypothetical example: for a current tag expiring on 20 May, the earliest day an extension can be issued is 13 May.

**Hypothetical comparison.** For an order registering in a state whose own limit is 2 extensions, Kestrel Title-Only Service allows 1 (the lower of 1 and 2), while Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection allows 2 (the lower of 3 and 2).
